_comment: One cognitive runtime and control-plane ingress. Native gRPC clients use the bridge directly; MCP clients use the local stdio adapter, which dispatches into that same bridge-owned runtime and never opens CozoDB.

endpoint.description: Single native gRPC surface — demux by service/method via reflection. Auth at socket connect (x-ghostbridge-footprint / x-ghostbridge-trace-id / x-wireguard-pubkey).

mcp_adapter.description: Protocol adapter for MCP-only clients; execution remains inside op-grpc-bridge

not_doors._comment: These are NOT separate MCP control-plane endpoints. Browser UI is :8080; chatbot loopback is not an external MCP door.

default.description: All MCP clients — one socket, full tool catalog after auth

local_chatbot.description: Chatbot also uses the socket door; lazy meta-tools are a client UX, not a second server
